intro: Miss Doris's friend from church gave her a list: 12 places on the car to rub baby oil. We tested every one in her driveway. 4 are great (faded black trim, sticker glue and tar, chrome, greasy hands), 8 are a waste or dangerous (dashboard glare, tires, door seals, headlights, steering wheel and pedals, leather, wipers, hinges and locks), plus 5 bonus myths, the hidden spot test and what the dealer's protection package really is. Episode 4 of "Miss Doris's Car".
